Class ShapeCanvas

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.canvas.Canvas
editor.ShapeCanvas
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class ShapeCanvas extends javafx.scene.canvas.Canvas
The ShapeCanvas class provides a custom drawing surface for creating, rendering, and managing shapes in the "ShapeEditor", a JavaFX application.

It extends Canvas and maintains an internal collection of MyShape objects, which are manually rendered using a GraphicsContext.

Features:

  • Draw and display shapes (lines, rectangles, ovals, and groups)
  • Interactive editing via interchangeable mouse event handlers
  • Undo/redo support using a command-based edit system
  • Shape selection (e.g., closest shape detection)
  • Persistence via text and binary file formats

Design Notes:

  • Rendering: The canvas is not reactive; all updates require explicit repainting via paint().
  • Edit System: Uses stacks of Edit objects to support undo/redo operations.
  • Event Handling: Mouse interactions are dynamically assigned through handler replacement.
  • Composite Shapes: Supports grouped shapes using ShapeGroup.

  • Constructor Details

    • ShapeCanvas

      public ShapeCanvas(double w, double h)
      Constructs a ShapeCanvas with the specified dimensions. It initializes the drawing surface, graphics context, shape storage, default drawing properties, and undo/redo stacks.
      • Default color is set to black
      • Shapes are unfilled by default
      • Undo/redo stacks are initialized as empty
      • Draws the initial canvas “paper” background and frame
      Parameters:
      w - The width of the canvas
      h - The height of the canvas

    • paint

      public void paint()
      Repaints the entire canvas by clearing the drawing area and rendering all shapes currently stored in the canvas. This method also renders a subtle background “paper” fill and a thin frame around the drawable region as a visual aid. If a shape is actively being created or edited, it is drawn on top of existing shapes.

    • addShape

      public void addShape(MyShape s)
      Adds a shape to the canvas and immediately refreshes the display.
      Parameters:
      s - the shape to be added

    • setCurrShape

      public void setCurrShape(MyShape s)
      Sets the current active shape being drawn or edited. If the shape is not null, it inherits the current color and fill settings.
      Parameters:
      s - the shape to set as the current shape

    • clear

      public void clear()
      Clears all shapes from the canvas and resets undo/redo history. The canvas is then repainted to reflect the empty state.

    • replaceMouseHandler

      public void replaceMouseHandler(javafx.event.EventHandler<javafx.scene.input.MouseEvent> listener)
      Replaces all mouse event handlers on the canvas with a single shared listener. This allows dynamic switching between different interaction modes (e.g., drawing, selecting, editing).
      Parameters:
      listener - the event handler for all mouse events

    • closestShape

      public MyShape closestShape(double x, double y)
      Finds the shape whose center is closest to the given (x, y) coordinate. This is used for selection and interaction operations.
      Parameters:
      x - the x-coordinate of the reference point
      y - the y-coordinate of the reference point
      Returns:
      the closest shape, or null if no shapes exist

    • undo

      public void undo()
      Undoes the most recent edit operation, if available. The undone operation is moved to the redo stack.

    • redo

      public void redo()
      Redoes the most recently undone operation, if available. The redone operation is moved back to the undo stack.

    • toTextFile

      public void toTextFile(File fileObj)
      Saves all shapes currently on the canvas to a human-readable text file. Each shape is written using its toString() representation, preceded by the total number of shapes in the file.
      Parameters:
      fileObj - the file to which shape data will be written

    • fromTextFile

      public void fromTextFile(File fileObj)
      Loads shapes from a text file and replaces the current canvas content. It supports both singleton shapes and nested ShapeGroups. Existing canvas state is cleared before loading to ensure consistency.
      Parameters:
      fileObj - the file to read shape data from

    • toBinaryFile

      public void toBinaryFile(File fileObj)
      Serializes and saves all shapes on the canvas to a binary file. Uses Java object serialization to store shape objects efficiently. Includes the number of shapes followed by each serialized object.
      Parameters:
      fileObj - the file to which binary data will be written

    • fromBinaryFile

      public void fromBinaryFile(File fileObj)
      Loads shapes from a binary file using Java object deserialization.

      Clears existing canvas content before restoring saved shapes. Restores the full object graph of all shapes including groups.

      Parameters:
      fileObj - the file to read binary shape data from
